Name: Em's Farm Goose and Geese
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Add four types of geese to the farm. They lay eggs, leave feathers and honk gently
There are four goose types are Embden, Canada, Scania and Greylag
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url]

[img]https://image2url.com/r2/default/images/1773401796535-9ebcfba3-99e9-4caf-ae79-73fd254464d3.png[/img]

Geese are protective and loyal birds who live in a coop
They make a gentle honk sound﻿ and eat two grass patches a day
If they have been pet, they might jump into the pond for a swim

Their eggs can be made into creamy goose mayo or pan-fried
They make a delicious lunch on a piece of toast
The feathers they drop are soft and white
You can craft a pillow or toy with them and a piece of cloth

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Farm Geese CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

These geese are added as a new animal to the game, so if you have SVE it's a bit of a double up
If you want to adjust the SVE geese, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36534]Em's Geese (SVE animals)[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39719]Em's [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39719]SVE collection bundle
